body:
Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-19 13:08Z, my own miss). Before sending a gate GO, wait for the other side's MAILED END of every warm series it announced. A single passed run in /api/test-runs does not end a series. I sent S1's gate GO at 13:07Z after seeing 8581's third run pass, but the series had a fourth run (test-548b54aa, which ended 13:07:55Z). It was harmless only because S1 was then withdrawn before launch (its own clippy warning). Engram::Fable disclosed it in #3579.

Second miss, 2026-10-19 18:34Z: Engram::Fable's #3708 said "START: Engram's one warm, S2.2 r1b". I treated the START as a plan the peer could still cancel, and sent the M5 gate GO at 18:34:38Z after /api/test-runs looked empty at 18:34:31Z. The fmt step had already passed at 18:34:49Z and Clippy was running at 18:34:59Z. Coder was told to HOLD, and its pre-launch test-runs check also guarded it. RULE: a peer mail that says START means the series is in flight NOW, even if /api/test-runs is empty between steps. Never send a gate GO until that series' mailed END. Always also require the launching lane to re-check /api/test-runs immediately before launch.
